rule: Trace distances between a shape-parameter variant and its baseline at the same camera (pairs, named by variant tag and camera: the variants d010 and cB at the cameras a26120005_c0 and n26130007_c0, baseline b055). baseline_positive_px: positive pixels of the baseline. The distance of a baseline pixel is its distance to the nearest line pixel of the variant (final centreline, unclear line or occluded line); distance_p99 and distance_max are its 99th percentile and maximum in pixels, and large_distance_px counts the baseline pixels whose distance exceeds 2 px. This line set does not contain the fracture-mouth pixels of the variant; the distances to the segments of all types that supplement S3 gives include them and are smaller. classes divides these pixels: a, the variant has no projected sample point of the same trace within 2 px (the path is shorter or ends); b, the variant has sample points of the same trace within 2 px, all outside the frame or below the ground; c, other. The trace of a baseline pixel is that of the nearest projected baseline sample point. shares = classes / large_distance_px.
